title: Retained migration status projections
summary: Dev8 ingests externally-subscribed migratable.job.status/1 projections into a local SQLite chained journal. It checks schema, identity, local sequence, monotonic flags, stale retained/redelivery cases and conflicting payloads; it never asserts provider authentication.
invariants: Status subscription delivery and status authorisation are different.
Source timestamps, migration sequence and local observation time must remain distinct.
Duplicate redelivery is idempotent; same-sequence conflicting payload is rejected; stale snapshots never rewind.
Hash chain is local tamper evidence, not a digital signature or external trust anchor.
A message saying RUNNING is not proof of an actually running or billed VM.
The observer does not write paper accounts.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Use a separately authorized Queue Fabric subscriber and explicit JSON projection.
Ingest with tools/migration-status-observer; reject bad schema/identity/transition.
Run audit before interpreting retained status; show OBSERVATION_ONLY and unauthenticated flags.
Use native lease and authoritative operational evidence before making subsequent decisions.
